# Capital plus Collaboration   leads to Scale

**Capria – _CAP ree ah_ – means ‘capital flow’**

We provide capital and global collaboration to tech companies in the Global South building scalable, profitable businesses that improve the lives of hundreds of millions.

Beyond financial backing, we bring a wealth of experience, industry insights, and networks that can significantly impact a startup’s trajectory. This mentorship aims to help startups avoid common pitfalls and guide them in refining their strategies, enhancing operations, and positioning themselves effectively in the competitive market landscape. By fostering innovation, driving job creation, and promoting economic growth, we strive to be catalysts for transforming groundbreaking concepts into thriving enterprises that drive change and solve problems.

[Explore Portfolio >](https://capria.vc/portfolio/focus/)

## investment PhilosophyA Global South specialist VC investing in   Applied AI

The Global South presents a multi-trillion dollar opportunity and applied AI will be a powerful catalyst for growth.

The youth of the Global South – roughly 25% of the 4B population – will grow up empowered by Generative and Agentic AI, increasing productivity and bridging language gaps never previously possible. No technology has impacted more people more quickly.

Capria Ventures is working across 300 portfolio companies to accelerate the adoption of Applied AI. We believe startups now must have a Applied AI strategy irrespective of the sector of investment. AI will be the talent and language equalizer, open up vast new markets and amplify the Global South’s demographic advantage.
